Package Server

Class WaitlistTimerService

java.lang.Object
Server.WaitlistTimerService
public class WaitlistTimerService extends Object
enforces the 1-hour confirmation window for waiting-list promotions.

when DBController.promoteFromWaitingList(int, java.sql.Date, java.sql.Time) promotes a visitor, it creates a HELD (pending) order, marks the waiting_list row NOTIFIED with a confirmation_deadline one hour out, and calls schedulePromotionTimeout(int) here. two independent mechanisms then guarantee the slot is released if the visitor never confirms:

  • a precise one-shot timer scheduled exactly 1 hour after the promotion, and
  • a recurring sweep every 5L minutes that catches any expired entry, including promotions whose one-shot timer was lost to a server restart.

both paths funnel through DBController.expireWaitlistEntry(Server.DBController.PromotedEntry), which is idempotent: if the visitor confirmed in the meantime the held order is no longer pending, so nothing is cancelled. on a genuine expiry the held order is cancelled, the visitor is notified (email + server "Simulation" popup), and the freed slot is promoted to the next person in line.

singleton; call start(DBController) once at server start. the executor thread is a daemon so it never blocks JVM shutdown, and all UI work is marshalled onto the FX thread.

    • showSimulationPopup

      static void showSimulationPopup(String title, String header, String content)
      shows a server-side "Simulation" notification popup styled with the GoNature server theme (pine/gold header strip, parchment background, green OK button). safe to call from any thread; marshals onto the JavaFX Application Thread via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable).
      Parameters:
      title - the window title shown in the OS title bar
      header - the bold text shown in the pine header strip (e.g. visitor email/ID)
      content - the body text with park name, date, time, and action taken
